subject: executor: Support TopN Spill (#51809)
summary: Adds spill-to-disk support for TopN via a memory-tracker spill action, worker heaps, and disk multi-way merge; the High-risk regressions present at this commit (panic when tidb_enable_tmp_storage_on_oom is disabled; spill action not invoking fallback) are fixed later on upstream/master (e.g. b20c3a39db, 7202c3825b), leaving no remaining Blocker/High issues.
